description:
Titanium or Steel Mini-Velo with a single sided titanium fork or traditional bladed fork.
NEUTRINO: (nyoo-tree-noh) A neutral subatomic particle with a mass close to zero that passes through normal matter unimpeded and undetected.
Whether you are a modern urban dweller pressed to maximize every square inch of space in your home, a bike commuter without the luxury of a purpose built bike parking area at work, or a traveler in need of a compact bicycle with the ride and performance of a traditional bike, our mini-velo is sure to please.
Neutrinos are available as custom builds only, made to order to fit each rider. Available as a titanium or steel frame with either traditional or a Lefty style (single-sided) fork, and either a belt drive or traditional derailleur gearing. These bikes are designed to pack maximum performance into a minimal package.
SPECS:
Available in titanium or steel frame
Available as a frame/fork set or as a complete build
Traditional titanium fork with disc brake standard
Optional Lefty style single-sided fork available
Aggressively shaped and butted oversize tube set for maximum performance and light weight
Mono-stay rear triangle for lighter and better lateral bracing
Sloping top tube creates a smaller, lighter and stiffer main triangle with more stand-over height
Rocker dropouts with interchangeable inserts for your choice of hubs
Belt Drive single speed configuration with rocker dropouts standard
Compatible with standard road, IGH or singe speed drivetrain
Custom cable routing
Size specific geometry
